paper_title: One Pot Synthesis of γ-Benzopyranones via Iron-Catalyzed Aerobic Oxidation and Subsequent 4-Dimethylaminopyridine Catalyzed 6-endo Cyclization

questions.question: In this paper what does the abbreviation 'DMAP' refer to?
What is the chemical name (as given in the paper) of compound 1a?
Which solvent was used in the reaction that afforded 3a in 85% NMR yield (82% isolated) from 1a?
Which solvent gave the higher yield of 3a from 1a: DCM or MeCN, and what were the reported yields?
questions.ground_truth_answer: MeCN gave the higher yield: MeCN 85% NMR (82% isolated) vs DCM 8% (3a detected).
